eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecast updates from Météo-France and ensemble models show a cooldown in Paris on August 15, 2026, with daytime highs likely reaching 30–33°C amid increasing cloud cover and afternoon thunderstorm risk. This follows a midweek heat peak near 37–38°C driven by southerly flow and clear skies, now shifting under a cooler northwesterly regime typical of late-summer Atlantic influences. Model consensus supports 32°C as the most probable maximum, aligning with the market’s leading 47% implied probability, while uncertainty in convective timing keeps 31°C and 33°C viable at 24% and 22.5%. Official observations through the day will resolve the market.

eventMetadata.context_description: The southwest monsoon, or habagat, remains the dominant driver suppressing peak temperatures across Metro Manila, with PAGASA forecasts indicating mostly cloudy skies, scattered rains, and a 30% rain chance on August 16 that limits solar heating and caps daytime maxima. Official outlooks project a range of 25–33°C, consistent with historical August averages near 31°C but moderated by high humidity and cloud cover typical of the wet season. Trader consensus clustering around 29–31°C reflects these conditions and recent model runs showing no immediate shift to clearer skies or stronger heating. Upcoming PAGASA updates and any changes in monsoon strength or local thunderstorm development will be key near-term signals for resolution.
